summary: Validates that the instance has a truthy sku and a positive qty, raising ValueError if either check fails.
inputs: self (object): Instance whose attributes are validated.
self.sku (any): SKU value; must be truthy to pass validation.
self.qty (number): Quantity value; must be greater than 0.
outputs: return (None): Returns None if both validations pass without raising an exception.
main_effect: Complete method execution without returning a value.
errors: ValueError: Raised when qty is non-positive.
ValueError: Raised when sku is missing or falsy.

control_structures.code:
if not self.sku:
            raise ValueError("sku is required")

if self.qty <= 0:
            raise ValueError("qty must be positive")
